label: ProductForge-Dashboard Backlog 137
title: Backlog orchestration UI: triage/accept/execute/schedule/manage backlogs (both scopes)
body: Dashboard backlog management (orchestrator view): filter by scope/status/type/origin/source, triage, accept(now|later), execute-now/schedule via JobManager, edit, close; reciprocal with the intake funnel + queue views. Backend: backlog.py + job_manager. Consumes the same stores as the static backlog.html.
